clue.text: Priest guards naughty steps in Rio

indicators.note: to guard something is to stand around it, so the priest's letters surround the next piece

parts.note: a lama is a Tibetan Buddhist priest
naughty means bad

explanation.surface: A clergyman keeps watch over some badly behaved dancing in Rio de Janeiro.
explanation.definitionFit: The lambada is a sensuous Brazilian dance, so its steps belong in Rio.

clue.text: Poet's current service inspires old long-distance caller

indicators.note: to inspire is literally to breathe in, so the river and service together take the letter for old inside them

parts.note: Alph is the sacred river in Coleridge's poem Kubla Khan
RN is the Royal Navy, one of the armed services

explanation.surface: A poet's electricity supply company breathes life into an old long-distance telephone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'current' looks electrical; it is a river's current, Coleridge's Alph.
explanation.definitionFit: The alphorn is an Alpine horn used to call across valleys, so it carries its call over a long distance.

clue.text: Bowl brilliant opener when batting

indicators.note: an opener is what comes first, so the first letter is taken

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
a side batting in cricket is in

explanation.surface: A cricketer bowls superbly at the opening batsman while his side bats.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the batting side is said to be 'in'.
explanation.definitionFit: A basin is a round open bowl for washing or mixing.

clue.text: Soprano's brought in to transfer top notes

indicators.note: brought in means put inside, so the soprano's letter enters the word for transfer

parts.note: to decant is to transfer a liquid from one vessel to another
S is the abbreviation for soprano; the 's is read as 'is'

explanation.surface: A soprano is drafted in to pass on the highest notes.
explanation.definitionFit: A descant is a melody sung above the main tune, so it supplies the highest notes.

clue.text: Roundabout very like one's stuck in the night before

indicators.note: pieces stuck in something are placed inside it, so the following letters go within the evening's

parts.note: eve is the evening or day before an occasion
as can mean like, in the same way as
one is the Roman numeral I; the 's is read as 'is'

explanation.surface: Someone describes a traffic circle the evening before, sounding very like a stuck motorist.
explanation.definitionFit: Roundabout as an adjective means indirect, avoiding the point, which is what an evasive answer is.

clue.text: After contest, woman raised capital

indicators.note: after means the woman's letters follow those for contest

parts.note: to vie is to compete or contest

indicators.note: raised means lifted up, so in this down clue the name reads upwards

parts.note: Ann is a woman's name

explanation.surface: After a competition, a woman raised money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like money; it is a capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: Vienna is the capital city of Austria.

clue.text: Below par albums Ron scrapped

indicators.note: scrapped means broken up, so the letters of these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Ron threw out some albums that were not up to standard.
explanation.definitionFit: Subnormal means lower than the usual level, i.e. not up to standard.

clue.text: Court supporting Italian barman's decision

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting piece goes below, so the court comes after the composer

parts.note: Verdi was an Italian composer; a composer is a 'barman' as music is written in bars

explanation.surface: A court backs an Italian bartender's ruling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'barman' looks like a pub worker; it is a man of musical bars, Verdi.
explanation.definitionFit: A verdict is a court's or jury's decision on a case.

clue.text: Who'd rewrite my revised 10?

definitions.note: 10-across is OPUS, a musical work; this is one

indicators.note: revised means altered, so the letters of these words are reordered

explanation.surface: Someone wonders who would rewrite their already revised piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Lehár's operetta The Merry Widow is a musical work, an example of the cross-referenced piece.

clue.text: Ring our lot about piano piece

indicators.note: about means around, so the ring and our lot are wrapped around the musical letter

parts.note: a ring is round, the shape of the letter O
our lot means us
p is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly

explanation.surface: A circle of friends gathers round a piano to hear a piece.
explanation.definitionFit: An opus is a numbered musical work, a composition or piece.

clue.text: US composer's chosen eccentric Austrian one

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or off-centre, so the letters of chosen are rearranged

parts.note: Alban Berg was an Austrian composer, one of the Second Viennese School

explanation.surface: An American composer has picked a quirky Austrian colleague.
explanation.walkthrough: Schoenberg was himself Austrian-born, so 'Austrian one' tempts as the definition; he became a US citizen in 1941, and Berg was his pupil.
explanation.definitionFit: Arnold Schoenberg emigrated to America in the 1930s and became a citizen there.

clue.text: Miss a grand perhaps

definitions.meaning: A girl's name, so a miss could be called that
... is Cockney rhyming slang for piano (.../pianna); a grand is a kind of piano

explanation.surface: A girl might be a thousand pounds, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockney rhyming slang is London working-class slang; 'joanna' rhymes with the old pronunciation 'pianna'. 'A grand' looks like a thousand pounds.
explanation.definitionFit: A grand piano is an example of the instrument the slang names, and a miss is a young woman with a name.

clue.text: Picky types hold this stag party, getting nothing back

parts.note: a stag party is for men, so stag gives man
a do is a party

indicators.note: back means the letters of the word for nothing are read in reverse

parts.note: nil means nothing

explanation.surface: Fussy people put up with a bachelor party only if it gives them nothing back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Picky types' are people who pick strings: mandolin players pluck with a plectrum.
explanation.definitionFit: A mandolin is plucked, so players who pick its strings are the ones who hold it.

clue.text: Parent adrift approaching river entrance

indicators.note: adrift means loose and wandering, so the letters of parent float into a new order

parts.note: the Ure is a river in North Yorkshire

explanation.surface: A parent drifting in a boat nears the mouth of a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entrance' reads as a noun, a river mouth, but it is the verb, to delight. The Ure is a river in Yorkshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: To entrance someone, as a verb, is to delight or captivate them, to send them into rapture.

clue.text: Agree with boss, pointing up instrument

parts.note: to accord is to agree

indicators.note: pointing up means reading upwards in this down clue, so the letters are reversed

parts.note: the boss is number one, written NO. I

explanation.surface: Siding with the boss and pointing upward with a tool.
explanation.definitionFit: An accordion is a musical instrument with bellows and a keyboard.

clue.text: They designed fiddles somewhat melodramatically

indicators.note: somewhat means partly, so only a portion of the next word supplies the letters

explanation.surface: Some people rigged things in a rather theatrical way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fiddles' suggests swindles; here they are violins.
explanation.definitionFit: The Amati family of Cremona were celebrated violin makers of the 16th and 17th centuries.

clue.text: Handle plant store, standard goods and cattle

definitions.meaning: the ... of a gun or tool is its handle
to ... goods is to store them
... means standard, as in a ... reply
livestock, or ..., is cattle and other farm animals

explanation.surface: A list of what a farm shop deals in: plants, supplies, ordinary goods and cattle.
explanation.definitionFit: The one word covers all six senses: a gun's handle, a flower, a verb to keep, a usual thing, merchandise, and livestock.

clue.text: Champion melody impressing member

indicators.note: impressing means pressing into, so the member goes inside the melody

parts.note: a tune is a melody
a rib is a member of a body's or boat's frame

explanation.surface: A winning tune wows a club member.
explanation.definitionFit: A tribune was a Roman officer protecting the plebeians, so the word means a champion of the people.

clue.text: Greek king, insignificant person, almost a hero

indicators.note: almost means not quite complete, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a pygmy is figuratively an insignificant person
a lion is a brave hero, as in a literary lion

explanation.surface: A Greek monarch is dismissed as a nobody who nearly made it as a hero.
explanation.definitionFit: Pygmalion was the legendary king of Cyprus in Greek myth who fell in love with his statue.

clue.text: Well-off male like Polyphemus losing heart

indicators.note: losing heart means the middle letter is removed

parts.note: Polyphemus was the Cyclops in the Odyssey, with one eye

explanation.surface: A rich man who looks like a Cyclops becomes downcast.
explanation.definitionFit: Moneyed means rich, having plenty of money.

clue.text: Music-maker's old vehicle, trendy one

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
in means fashionable or trendy
a means one

explanation.surface: A musician's vintage motor is a fashionable one.
explanation.definitionFit: The ocarina is a small egg-shaped wind instrument, so it makes music.

clue.text: Mike opens fizzy stout, the greatest

indicators.note: the letter opens the drink by going into it
fizzy suggests bubbling up, so the letters of stout are stirred up

parts.note: Mike is M in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Mike cracks open a bubbly stout, the best ever.
explanation.definitionFit: The utmost is the greatest amount or degree possible.

clue.text: Product of Gilbert, heading off with it

definitions.text: Product of Gilbert, heading off with it

indicators.note: a product is something made from material, so these letters are worked into a new form
heading off means the first letter is removed

explanation.surface: Something W. S. Gilbert wrote, after he set off taking it along.
explanation.walkthrough: Gilbert without G gives ILBERT; with IT, those letters are rearranged. The whole clue is also the definition: Gilbert wrote the words for Sullivan's operettas.
explanation.definitionFit: W. S. Gilbert wrote the words, the libretti, for the Savoy operas set by Sullivan.

clue.text: Fair to be arranged with sign outside

indicators.note: outside means the sign's letters go round the abbreviation

parts.note: a nod is a sign of assent

explanation.surface: A fair is still to be organised, with a signpost outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be arranged' looks like an anagram signal; it is the abbreviation TBA.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying something is middling or reasonably good, the phrase means fair or passable.

clue.text: Old king has what's needed erected all at once

parts.note: Tut is short for Tutankhamun, the ancient Egyptian king

indicators.note: erected means set upright, so in this down clue the letters read upwards

parts.note: it is the very thing needed, as in 'that's it'

explanation.surface: An ancient king has his essential monuments put up all together.
explanation.definitionFit: Tutti in music means all the performers playing together, at the same time.

clue.text: American in charge of old journal blocks my study

indicators.note: to block something is to fill its space, so these pieces sit inside the word my

parts.note: a log is a journal or record

explanation.surface: An American official in charge of an old periodical obstructs my research.
explanation.definitionFit: Musicology is the academic discipline of music, a field of scholarly study.

clue.text: Section of choir temporarily recalled group

indicators.note: recalled means called back, so the letters are read backwards
a section is a part, so the letters are taken from within the words that follow

explanation.surface: Part of a choir has been brought back for a while as a smaller ensemble.
explanation.definitionFit: A trio is a group of three, especially of musicians.

clue.text: Leading economist briefly goes over books

indicators.note: going over something means covering it, so the economist's letters wrap round the books
briefly means cut short, so the last letter is lost

parts.note: John Maynard Keynes was the British economist
OT is the Old Testament, a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: A top economist, in short, reviews the accounts.
explanation.definitionFit: A keynote speech or idea is the leading or principal one, setting the tone.

clue.text: One in drama at sea, line astern?

definitions.text: One in drama at sea, line astern?

indicators.note: astern means behind a ship, so the line's letter comes last
in means the numeral goes inside the rearranged letters
at sea means confused and all over the place, so the letters of drama are jumbled

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone in a naval drama orders the fleet to sail in line astern.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also describes the answer: an admiral in a sea drama commanding ships in line astern, one behind another.
explanation.definitionFit: An admiral commands a fleet at sea and could order a formation in line astern.
